payload.claim: No test in this diff (or anywhere in test_report.py) exercises the exact real-world case this spec is fixing: an errored rebuttal turn that still moved HEAD and for which the critic still produced verdicts (`RebutResult.verdicts` non-empty). `run_rebut` only skips verdicting when `not moved and not any(argued)`; when `moved` is True (as in the SA-0040/PR#93 story itself: '0 rebuttal(s), HEAD moved, not the schema: ...'), verdicts still run even though `rebuttal.error` is set. Every new 'errored' test case in this diff passes `verdicts=[]`, so a regression that nests `verdicts = {...}` inside `if not errored:` (making the errored row's critic column silently go back to `—` even when a real 'confirmed'/'withdrawn' verdict exists) would keep every test in this diff green while defeating acceptance criterion 3 ('Each row still carries its own blocker's rebuttal and verdict') in precisely the scenario the spec was written to fix.
